sources.title: Toolbox for the Modeling and Analysis of Thermodynamic Systems (T-MATS) User's Guide
sources.repository_policy: The public report PDF remains external to this repository. Extracted reference values and provenance are tracked here.

sources.title: AGTF30 MEX steady-state solver and linearization tool

reference_case.description: T-MATS and NPSS steady design-point comparison using the same public maps and constants
reference_case.published_interpretation: The report states that the listed T-MATS and NPSS steady-state differences are below 0.5 percent.

declared_assumptions: The total station-2 air flow is split into 0.768 N2 and 0.232 O2 mass fractions for the Cantera material basis.
Published compressor torque is converted to shaft power at the published 10000 rpm; it is not an independently tabulated power measurement.
The T-MATS source map and its three published scaler values are inputs, not fitted Thermox parameters.

acceptance.criterion: Absolute relative error below 0.5 percent for station-3 pressure, station-3 temperature, and shaft power inferred from compressor torque.

agtf30_off_design_execution.selection: Five converged rows with nominal health parameters and zero sensor/actuator biases; the degraded-health and biased-sensor rows are excluded.
agtf30_off_design_execution.bleed_model: A generic instance-sized fractional-bleed port group reproduces the three declared AGTF30 extractions and their pressure/enthalpy state fractions; no case-specific correction is fitted.

agtf30_hpt_inverse_map_execution.selection: The same five converged nominal-health, zero-bias operating points used for the HPC slice.
reserved_comparisons: HPT outlet temperature until combustor product composition replaces the declared simplified N2/O2 boundary.
Net HP-shaft balance until compressor, combustor, turbine, and power extraction are connected.

agtf30_coupled_high_spool_execution.chemistry: agtf30_major_products.yaml; seven-species methane-air HP equilibrium using GRI-Mech 3.0 thermodynamic species data
agtf30_coupled_high_spool_execution.boundary_contract: Station 25 state and flow, HP shaft speed, and 350 hp extraction are fixed. Fuel flow, station 4, turbine pressure ratio, and station 45 are solved.
reserved_comparisons: Fuel-flow predictive qualification: Thermox solves 12.01 to 12.77 percent below the T-MATS command and no calibration is applied.
Independent hardware validation and whole-engine net-thrust/nozzle performance.

agtf30_coupled_low_spool_execution.selection: The same five converged nominal-health, zero-bias operating points used for the HPC, HPT, and coupled high-spool slices.
agtf30_coupled_low_spool_execution.boundary_contract: Station 2 pressure/temperature and the NASA-solved fan R-line are fixed; fan flow is reconstructed from the source map. Station 23 flow/state, station 48 pressure/temperature, LPT exit cooling state/flow, and N2 speed are fixed. LPT main flow is relaxed and solved from map compatibility plus LP-shaft closure.
agtf30_coupled_low_spool_execution.topology: A generic multi-load shaft train connects the LPT driver to the LPC and to a separately composed fixed-ratio fan gearbox at N2/3.1, with declared shaft efficiency 0.99 and gearbox efficiency 1.0.
reserved_comparisons: Continuous gas-path prediction: the splitter, core/bypass ducts, variable bleed valve, and nozzles are not connected in this station-sliced declaration.
Independent fan R-line prediction: NASA's solved R-line substitutes for the downstream gas-path constraint omitted from this slice.
Independent hardware and transient validation.

agtf30_continuous_twin_spool_execution.selection: Four healthy nominal cases whose NASA variable-bleed-valve command is zero; the sea-level-static case is reserved because its command is nonzero.
agtf30_continuous_twin_spool_execution.boundary_contract: Station 2 pressure/temperature, N1/N2 shaft speeds, published bypass ratio, fuel temperature, and 350 hp HP extraction are fixed. Total inlet flow, fan map coordinate, fuel flow, intermediate station states, and both turbine pressure ratios are solved.
agtf30_continuous_twin_spool_execution.topology: A continuous material graph connects fan, controlled core/bypass split, LPC, three-bleed HPC, equilibrium combustor, two-injection HPT, and one-injection LPT. Generic multi-load HP and LP shaft trains close simultaneously, with the fan gearbox composed separately.
omitted_source_physics: Mach-dependent core and bypass duct pressure losses
core and bypass convergent nozzles and net thrust
reserved_comparisons: Fuel-flow predictive qualification: no case-specific calibration is applied to the retained 15.66 to 16.09 percent cross-model difference.
Whole-engine flow/thrust prediction until duct, variable-bleed-valve, and nozzle constraints are connected.
Independent hardware and transient validation.
Whole-engine flow and thrust until core/bypass nozzles close both terminal paths.
The nonzero-VBV point until a generic VBV is connected.
Fuel prediction, independent hardware validation, and transient validation.

agtf30_nozzle_closed_twin_spool_executio.boundary_contract: Station 2 pressure/temperature, LP speed, VAFN area, ambient pressure, fuel temperature, and 350 hp extraction are fixed. Inlet flow, both compressor coordinates, bypass ratio, fuel, HP speed, both turbine pressure ratios, and all downstream states are solved.
agtf30_nozzle_closed_twin_spool_executio.source_nozzle_contract: Two convergent nozzles; source Cd=1, bypass Cfg=0.9975, core Cfg=0.9999, core throat=393.43 in2, and case-scheduled bypass VAFN area.
reserved_comparisons: Net thrust until ambient/inlet ram drag is connected.
Sea-level-static nonzero-VBV qualification is recorded separately in agtf30_vbv_nozzle_static_execution.
Fuel-flow predictive qualification, independent hardware evidence, and transient validation.

agtf30_vbv_nozzle_twin_spool_execution.source_valve_contract: T-MATS Valve_TMATS pressure-ratio curve with position from zero to fully open, effective area 4.0 in2, and reference corrected-flow conversion at 14.696 psia and 518.67 degR.
agtf30_vbv_nozzle_twin_spool_execution.topology: The generic cross-bleed junction removes mapped flow at LPC discharge composition and conservatively mixes species and enthalpy into the fan bypass stream before duct 17.
reserved_comparisons: The fifth nonzero-VBV qualification is recorded separately in agtf30_vbv_nozzle_static_execution.
Net thrust until generic freestream ram drag is connected.
Fuel-flow predictive qualification, independent hardware evidence, and transient validation.

agtf30_vbv_open_point_execution.source_contract: Valve_TMATS_body.c: W = Wc(Pt24a/Pt13) * Pt24a / sqrt(Tt24a) * (position * 4.0 in2), capped by donor flow.
agtf30_vbv_open_point_execution.qualified_station_boundary: The five-point coupled low-spool benchmark supplies Pt24a, Tt24a, Pt13, donor flow, and bypass flow for the public static point.
reserved_comparisons: Fully coupled sea-level-static whole-engine solution while static nozzle/VBV closure is conditioned.
The Valve_TMATS donor-flow cap in a capacity-limited operating point.
Net thrust, independent hardware evidence, fuel-flow predictive qualification, and transient validation.

agtf30_vbv_bypass_branch_execution.boundary_contract: Donor state/flow, receiver enthalpy/flow, VBV position, ambient pressure, and VAFN area are fixed. Receiver pressure, VBV flow, duct loss, nozzle Mach, and gross thrust are solved simultaneously.
agtf30_vbv_bypass_branch_execution.topology: The generic map-bound cross-bleed receiver feeds the generic Mach-scaled duct-17 instance and scheduled-area convergent bypass nozzle.
reserved_comparisons: Fully coupled sea-level-static whole-engine solution; current staged retry is limited by LP-turbine/shaft closure rather than the bypass branch.
Net thrust until generic freestream ram drag is connected.
Independent hardware evidence, fuel-flow predictive qualification, and transient validation.

agtf30_core_exhaust_branch_execution.boundary_contract: LPT-exit enthalpy, N2/O2 flow, core-nozzle area, and ambient pressure are fixed. Station-5 pressure, duct loss, nozzle Mach, and gross thrust are solved simultaneously.
agtf30_core_exhaust_branch_execution.topology: The generic Mach-scaled duct-5 instance feeds the fixed-area generic convergent core nozzle.
agtf30_core_exhaust_branch_execution.declared_limit: The N2/O2 boundary inherited from the low-spool qualification validates terminal capacity and pressure closure, not combustion-product composition or independently measured thrust.

agtf30_vbv_nozzle_static_execution.boundary_contract: Station-2 pressure/temperature, LP speed, NASA VAFN area, ambient pressure, fuel temperature, VBV position, and 350 hp extraction are fixed. Inlet flow, compressor coordinates, bypass ratio, fuel, HP speed, turbine pressure ratios, VBV flow, nozzle flows, and all downstream states are solved.
agtf30_vbv_nozzle_static_execution.numerical_path: A capacity-matched initial state from the qualified terminal subsystems continues both nozzle-area fixed values to the unchanged NASA targets. The target equations and acceptance outputs are independent of initial guesses.
reserved_comparisons: Fuel-flow predictive qualification: the retained -15.24 percent cross-model difference is not calibrated away.
Gross-thrust source comparison until the public result field is independently extracted; net thrust until generic freestream ram drag is connected.
Independent hardware evidence and transient validation.

required_before_qualification: Resolve the retained HP/LP extraction-gain and fuel-gain differences before predictive qualification.

agtf30_transient_structural_probe.derivation: The public static declaration is initialized from its converged target state; steady shaft trains are replaced by generic inertial counterparts; LP speed is released and the converged Thermox fuel flow is fixed.
agtf30_transient_structural_probe.declared_limit: This probe qualifies DAE composition and equilibrium hold only. It does not compare a perturbation response, time history, or NASA A/B matrix and is not transient predictive validation.

nonlinear_trajectory_verification.declared_limit: This compares nominal-versus-perturbed Thermox nonlinear DAE trajectories with the integrated Thermox A/B model. No public NASA time-history reference is available, so it is a finite-window self-consistency qualification rather than transient predictive validation.

output_linearization_partial_reproductio.declared_limit: Only two total-pressure outputs are compared. The result does not qualify all 64 NASA output rows, a nonlinear time history, or independent hardware prediction.

agtf30_small_signal_partial_reproduction.declared_limit: All three public inputs are represented and the local linear model passes finite-window nonlinear self-consistency probes, but HP/LP extraction and fuel gains retain material cross-code differences and no NASA time history is compared. This does not qualify transient prediction.

interpretation_limit: These tests validate deterministic import, coordinate-map interpolation, off-design thermochemistry, nonzero variable-bleed flow and routing, predictive static terminal pressure closure, a fully coupled open-VBV static whole-engine point, bleed/cooling routing, duct loss, nozzle capacity, exact two-shaft conservation, full-graph transient DAE composition/equilibrium hold, and a complete-input but partial small-signal cross-code reproduction against public NASA code paths. They are not independent hardware validation, net-thrust qualification, fuel-flow predictive qualification, or full transient predictive validation.
